Lekkerfaces: Manic grinning face with gold spiral 'psycho mode' eyes - the hyper, unhinged Dutch uptempo energy of the 'faces' name.
Toza: Lightning bolt with gold speed streaks - 'GO FAST' hyper-energy rawstyle that is unbreakable.
The Straikerz: Football in motion with gold kick streaks - a 'striker' pun on kickrolls, keeping the playful 'Kickroll Is Not A Crime' spirit.
Noisemakers: Megaphone blasting jagged gold noise waves - raw, loud, literally making noise.
Slaughterhouse: Tilted butcher's cleaver with gold edge glint and hang-hole - stylised horror-hardcore 'slaughterhouse' tool, no gore.
Greazy Texas Fuckerz: Cowboy hat with a gold lone star and a dripping gold grease drop - Lil Texas cowboy chaos meets greasy GPF party.
Technikore & JTS: Old-school boombox with gold speakers - UK happy hardcore rave nostalgia, 'We Came 2 Rave'.
Frontliner: Beamed pair of music notes with a gold sparkle - 'The Melodyman' and his euphoric melodies.
Wildstylez: Rising sun with gold rays over a gold wave - the euphoric, timeless 'Year Of Summer' feeling.
Gammer: Microwave with gold dials and a gold heat wave - Gammer's meme-famous microwave edits and UK hardcore heat.
Tha Playah: Jester's cap with gold bells - the joker-ish 'Why So Serious?' persona of the mainstream hardcore legend.
Satirized: Ferris wheel ringed with gold bulbs - the 'Neon Funfair Live' show.
Yoshiko: Gold-spotted egg with a zigzag crack - playful cute-chaos nod to 'I Could Be Yoshi', something insolent hatching.
Major Conspiracy: Gear stick with a gold H-pattern on the knob and a rubber boot - 'Vol Gas! 2nd Gear', full throttle.
Noxiouz: Erlenmeyer flask with a gold bubbling reaction and spark - 'The Catalyst', chemistry about to kick off.
The Dope Doctor: Ghost with a gold medical cross - 'Ghost Mode' meets the Doctor, an X-ray-ward apparition.
Da Mouth of Madness: Plague-doctor beak mask in a top hat with a gold peacock-eye lens - the 'Tribute to Dr. Peacock' frenchcore plague-doctor vibe.
